item.spellclasses.laplace_ring.lore.lege: Legend: a ring of the ancient evil god Laplace, granting its wearer a vast reserve of mana.
item.spellclasses.laplace_ring.lore.effe: Laplace Factor: +2000 max mana, -50% spell cooldown and -20% mana cost for 5 minutes.
item.spellclasses.laplace_ring.lore.afte: When the effect ends: weakness, blindness, nausea, slowness and poison for 1 minute.
item.spellclasses.laplace_ring.lore.cool: Activates immediately on equip. Cooldown: 10 minutes.
spellclasses.message.laplace_on_cooldown: Laplace's Ring is still recovering (%s s left).
spellclasses.class.fire.desc: A denizen of the Nether's depths. Become this world's Herald of Ruin, master Hellfire, and challenge the lord Ignis.
spellclasses.class.ice.desc: Undead who commands the Cold and its Draugr. Turn your heart to Ice, find Maledictus's Frozen Prison, and take his place.
spellclasses.class.lightning.desc: Heir to the Skies, command Thunder and Lightning to reach the Cloud Acropolis with untold technology.
spellclasses.class.nature.desc: Child of the forest and the Living Caves. Your duty is to protect nature and its people. Only you stand in Harmony with nature and its Warden.
spellclasses.class.ender.desc: A being from another world that tore its way into ours. It rips open rifts in space and is nearly impossible to catch. Seek the aid of this world's creatures to defeat the Monster that took your Home.
spellclasses.class.blood.desc: Master of the Dead and of Night. The Dead King stripped you of your dominion over the departed - you must hunt him down and take your revenge.
spellclasses.class.holy.desc: A holy father who shields this world's people from Sin and Death. Your duty is to guide and protect your kin through their long journey.
spellclasses.screen.subtitle: This choice cannot be changed on your own
